query: SELECT cl.id, cl.moduleId, cm.title as moduleName, cl.title as lessonTitle, cl.orderIndex, LENGTH(cl.content) as contentLength FROM course_lessons cl JOIN course_modules cm ON cm.id = cl.moduleId WHERE LENGTH(cl.content) < 7000 ORDER BY cm.id, cl.orderIndex;
